command:
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial and p.vid==0x303A]
if len(m)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one emulator C6, got {[p.device for p in m]}')
print(m[0].device)
PY
); echo EMU_PORT=$PORT; echo '=== NO-RESET ROM SYNC PROBE ==='; set +e; python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$PORT" --before no_reset --after no_reset chip_id 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; echo NO_RESET_ESPTOOL_RC=$RC; if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo ROM_STATE=DOWNLOAD_MODE_CONFIRMED; else echo ROM_STATE=NOT_CONFIRMED_APP_MAY_BE_RUNNING; fi
